entities.summary: Juan de la Jaraquemada, ; Spanish soldier, designated by the viceroy of Peru Juan de Mendoza y Luna, Marquess of Montesclaros, Captain General and Governor of Chile, and president of the Real Audiencia of Santiago. He served from January 1, 1611 to March 27, 1612
